mapper.select: select * from `user` where user_id = #{num} and status >= 10
select * from `user` order by status, user_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select * from `user` where user_name_lookup = #{userName,typeHandler=com.chinahitech.shop.utils.NameLookupTypeHandler} order by status
mapper.insert: insert into `user` ( user_id, password, email, email_lookup, salt, create_time, modify_time, status ) values ( #{userId}, #{password}, #{email,typeHandler=com.chinahitech.shop.utils.EmailTypeHandler}, #{email,typeHandler=com.chinahitech.shop.utils.EmailLookupTypeHandler}, #{salt}, #{createTime}, #{modifyTime}, #{status} )
mapper.update: update `user` set campus = #{campus}, school = #{school}, major = #{major}, modify_time = #{modifyTime} where user_id = #{userId} and status >= 10
